label: Science attention triage

preamble_lines: Triage every case in this packed {evidence_mode} packet.
Return only the required structured JSON.

calibration.oracle_meaning: Theoretical ceiling: perfect triage + exact evidence on frozen ground truth for this scenario.

output_shape_hint: Return ONLY JSON. results length must equal case count. Each result needs case_id, title, attention_fit (boolean), priority (high|medium|skip), signals[]. priority MUST be skip when attention_fit is false. signal_type is relevance_hook|method_signal|impact_claim. evidence_quote must be an exact substring (≥10 chars) of the matching source text.
